structure: NJSLS-SS 2020 grade-band file for grades 6-8 (end of grade 8). Front matter (pp.1-12) identical to the K-2 and 3-5 files. Then 'By End of Grade 8 / Disciplinary Concepts' tables per strand (Civics; Geography; Economics; History): Disciplinary Concept | Description | Core Ideas. Then 'About the NJSLS-SS Eras' lists: 6.1 Eras 3-5 (Revolution and the New Nation 1754-1820s; Expansion and Reform 1801-1861; Civil War and Reconstruction 1850-1877) and 6.2 Eras 1-4 (Beginnings of Human Society; Early Civilizations; Classical Civilizations; Expanding Exchanges and Encounters 500-1450 CE). Standards 6.1 U.S. History and 6.2 World History/Global Studies are organized by era (era heading + short narrative + table Core Idea | Performance Expectations); Standard 6.3 Active Citizenship in the 21st Century by the End of Grade 8 is organized by strand/disciplinary concept. PE codes: 6.1.8.<Strand><Concept>.<era>.<letter> (e.g. 6.1.8.CivicsPI.3.a), 6.2.8.<...>.<era>.<letter>, 6.3.8.<Strand><Concept>.<n>. The era is in the code, the grade is the 6-8 band (end of grade 8). Core ideas sit in C1 of each PE row, PEs in the next cell. No courses; all labeled 6-8. Era narratives are labeled examples; Description column cells of the disciplinary concept tables labeled examples.
